sections.title: سادساً: التحليل الرابع — الأسئلة الشائعة
sections.content: الأسئلة الشائعة المستخرجة من بيانات المتعاملين.

rows.السؤال: How can I check if I have a traffic violation in Fujairah?
rows.الإجابة المقترحة: You can verify traffic violations through the Fujairah Police app or the Ministry of Interior smart services portal. If no violation appears, it means none has been recorded in Fujairah.

rows.السؤال: Is my Fujairah driving license valid across all UAE emirates?
rows.الإجابة المقترحة: Yes, a Fujairah driving license is recognized and valid across all UAE emirates in accordance with the federal traffic system.

rows.السؤال: Who approves weapons licensing requests and how long does it take?
rows.الإجابة المقترحة: Weapons permit approvals are decided by the specialized committee within the Weapons & Explosives Directorate. The committee evaluates each request independently. Fujairah Police coordinates on your behalf, but approval timelines depend on the committee.

rows.السؤال: How do I correctly select and pay for a vehicle license plate in the app?
rows.الإجابة المقترحة: Open the app and navigate to the vehicle plate selection section. The system displays all available plate types with selection and payment instructions. Follow the on-screen steps carefully. If you selected the wrong option, contact customer service for correction.

rows.السؤال: Can a non-Finnish resident exchange a Finnish driving license in the UAE?
rows.الإجابة المقترحة: No. According to the federal traffic system, exchanging a Finnish driving license is only available to Finnish nationals. Non-Finnish holders must follow standard driving license procedures.

rows.السؤال: How do I update my name in the traffic system if it is linked to my digital identity?
rows.الإجابة المقترحة: The traffic system is linked to the digital identity (Emirates ID). To update your name, you must visit the General Directorate of Nationality and Identity (ICA) to amend your records first, after which the traffic system will be updated accordingly.
